subject: Control Plane federation readiness & role-mapping workback
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: idp-admin@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Federation for Private Control Plane - kickoff and metadata

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the work to federate our IdP with Redwood's private control plane for the Acme deployment in our VPC. High level asks: SAML SSO (SP metadata), SCIM provisioning for service accounts and a role->group mapping proposal.

I've attached our IdP metadata (acme-idp-metadata.xml) and a CSV of a few test users. Can your team confirm the required attribute mappings (email, name, groups) and where we should post the SP metadata? Also: we need guidance on how Redwood expects role names to be presented for automatic mapping (e.g., "redwood:Admin", "redwood:Viewer").

Proposed timeline: start integration in the week of Jan 4, 2027 with an initial smoke test and SCIM push. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
SRE Lead, Acme Cloud
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Federation for Private Control Plane - kickoff and metadata

Hi Alice —

Thanks for sending the metadata and test CSV. Quick confirmations from our side so we can scope the work:

- We support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO; for Private CP installs the control plane expects an SP metadata XML (we will provide) and a single assertion consumer URL per region.
- SCIM: Redwood's SCIM accepts v2 with bearer token auth. We'll need a service account (we can generate on our side) or you can present a test token for the first push.
- Required SAML attributes: NameID (transient or persistent), email (mail / userPrincipalName), and a groups attribute. Groups can be a single claim with comma-separated values or multiple group claims.
- Role mapping: we recommend group names prefixed with "redwood:" (e.g. redwood:admin, redwood:service-account) to allow automated mapping. If that's not possible, we can supply a mapping table.

Next steps I propose:
1) We share SP metadata and ACS/SLO endpoints by EOD today.
2) You upload your IdP metadata to the secure S3 link we provide and confirm thumbprint.
3) Marcus will coordinate the SCIM token exchange and provide a small test harness.
4) Laura and David will draft a role-mapping spreadsheet; we ask Acme to mark at least two test groups for initial mapping.

If the Jan 4 date works, we'll schedule a 60-min kickoff on Jan 4 to run through handshake, exchange tokens, and run an initial SCIM push.

I'll attach the SP metadata as soon as it's signed.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Product Manager, Identity — Redwood Inference
From: IDP Admin <idp-admin@acmecloud.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: alice.nguyen@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-12-20T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Federation for Private Control Plane - kickoff and metadata

Hannah,

Thanks — timeline looks good. A couple of notes from the IdP side:

- Our IdP emits groups as a multi-valued claim (urn:oid:2.5.4.11) and also exposes a flat "memberOf" attribute in the SAML assertion. We can namespace group names but will need the exact prefix you want us to use.
- We've attached a small SCIM CSV (scim-test-users.csv) with two service accounts and three human testers. The service accounts are tagged in the CSV with "service_account" in an attribute column.
- For security we prefer to present SCIM over an allowlisted egress IP and a short-lived token. We'll need the egress range for the private control plane endpoint.

Also, for auditing we need to know: where will audit logs of SSO events be stored and will Acme receive a daily delivery of authentication events?

I'll wait for your SP metadata and the egress IP range.

Regards,
IDP Admin
Acme Cloud Identity Operations
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: IDP Admin <idp-admin@acmecloud.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-21T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Federation for Private Control Plane - kickoff and metadata

On Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 02:42 PM IDP Admin <idp-admin@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> Hannah,
>
> Thanks — timeline looks good. A couple of notes from the IdP side:
>
> - Our IdP emits groups as a multi-valued claim (urn:oid:2.5.4.11) and also exposes a flat "memberOf" attribute in the SAML assertion. We can namespace group names but will need the exact prefix you want us to use.

That's perfect — please use the prefix: redwood:role:<role-name> (example: redwood:role:admin, redwood:role:reader, redwood:role:svc). That pattern maps cleanly into our RBAC model and avoids collisions with other group naming schemes.

Regarding SCIM egress range: our Private CP control-plane endpoint for Acme will use the following egress IPs for outbound SCIM callbacks and health-checks (these are the IPs to allow): 34.201.12.88, 34.201.12.89. We'll also provide a short-lived bearer token for the initial test push.

Auditing: Redwood will stream SSO and SCIM events to an API endpoint under your account; we can push daily digests to an S3 bucket you specify or provide a joint CloudWatch/Stackdriver forwarder. We'll include the SAML subject, timestamp, assertion id, and SCIM provisioning events in the audit stream.

Marcus will follow up with the test harness and a small role-mapping workbook (attached: role-mapping-proposal.xlsx).

Action items for Acme before kickoff on Jan 4:
- Confirm you can prefix groups using the pattern above OR request a manual mapping.
- Provide an S3 bucket or endpoint for daily audit delivery (if you want it).
- Confirm an admin email for IdP error alerts.

I'll send calendar invite for the Jan 4 kickoff with a short agenda.

Thanks,
—Hannah
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmecloud.com>, idp-admin@acmecloud.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-21T15:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Federation for Private Control Plane - kickoff and metadata

Hi team — quick technical notes before the kickoff:

- SP metadata (attached to Hannah's earlier mail) includes the ACS URL: https://privcp.acme.redwood-inference/internal/saml/acs and the entityID: https://privcp.acme.redwood-inference/saml2.
- For SCIM, our implementation accepts bulk PUTs to /scim/v2/Users and supports the following extension attribute for service accounts: "urn:redwood:params:scim:2.0:ServiceAccount:serviceAccount": true/false. Please set that in the CSV for the two service accounts.
- Rate limits: the SCIM endpoint allows 50 req/min for initial provisioning; for large imports we can negotiate a temporary raising window.
- Test users: please include one human tester with MFA enabled so we can validate login flows and conditional access.

If you want, Marcus and I can run the SCIM push in a screenshare during kickoff to confirm mapping and error handling.

Cheers,
David
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: acme-idp-metadata.xml, scim-test-users.csv, role-mapping-proposal.xlsx
